description: Proof-style graphic pairing two Q-posted photographs of an IWC Schaffhausen wristwatch and pen with a screenshot of a POTUS_Schedule (@45_Schedule) tweet. Watch #1 (posted Jan 5, 2019) is annotated as showing 3:15 and Watch #2 (posted March 2, 2019) as 3:42; red lines connect them to the tweet stating William Barr authorized the border national-emergency declaration at 3:42 PM EST on March 15, 2019. The caption 'HOW DID Q KNOW??????' claims the watch times predicted the event.
text: Watch #1: 3:15. Posted Jan 5, 2019. Watch #2: 3:42. Posted March 2, 2019. POTUS_Schedule. @45_Schedule. Follow. March 15, 2019: Declaration of a National Emergency on the Southern Border was authorized by US Attorney General William Barr in the Oval Office at 3:42 PM EST. 3:48 PM - 15 Mar 2019. 1,006 Retweets 1,753 Likes. 494. 1.0K. 1.8K. HOW DID Q KNOW??????
flags: Graphic's claim that the watch times predicted the Barr authorization is an unverified Q-proof interpretation
@45_Schedule is an unofficial account, not a government source

description: Photograph, posted by Q with drop #3231, of a stainless-steel IWC Schaffhausen Portugieser-style chronograph wristwatch with a silver-white dial, blued hands, black leather strap and deployant clasp, lying face-up on a dark desk surface. The date window shows 19. The image is shot at an oblique angle in portrait orientation with black letterboxing top and bottom; these recurring watch photos are treated by followers as timestamp markers.
flags: Exact time shown on the dial is hard to read at this angle; follower interpretations of the time are claims, not shown fact

description: Close-up photograph, posted by Q with drop #3232, of a stainless-steel IWC Schaffhausen chronograph wristwatch (Portugieser-style, silver-white dial, blued hands, two subdials, black alligator-grain leather strap) lying on a dark desk edge, shot rotated so the 12 o'clock marker faces right. The date window shows 27, matching the March 27, 2019 posting date. Part of the recurring series of Q watch photos read by followers as timestamp markers.
